issues: Procedures note: Appearance procedures are covered only by "surgery, fillers or other injectables", and the note says to talk to a professional "before considering any treatment". The same section also says the golden ratio is a "planning reference" in cosmetic surgery. That reads as neutral planning guidance and weakens the advice against procedures.
